title.narrative: National Indigenous Disabled Women Association Nepal

description.narrative: NIDWAN's mission is to promote a decent standard of living for all indigenous women, women with disabilities and young indigenous women with disabilities and to advance social, economic, political and cultural rights to create a more just society. The Equality Fund grant will support NIDWAN's core operational costs including salaries and the following activities: -Administrative/transportation expenses to support and increase the capacity of the organization in key programmatic and operational areas. -Training of indigenous women with disabilities about their rights: training on human rights provisions, CEDAW, Convention on the rights of people with disabilities. -Data collection for proposal writing and for advocacy and campaigns.
